newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall on profit-taking.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices fell to 1,186/1,187 rupees per quintal on Tuesday after rising to 1,191/1,192, dealers said.
Sentiment was firm as traders were expecting lower new crops and the market to move to the 1,200 rupee mark, one dealer said.
Groundnut oil fell from 344/345 rupees to 340/341 rupees per 10 kg on higher arrivals of 100 tonnes and sluggish physical buying.
In Rajkot spot oil fell by five rupees to 520/525 rupees per 15 kg. The markets are closed on Wednesday for Christmas and will resume on Thursday.
